evidence.observation: H701 reads 417.43 °C, markedly above H702 at 83.626 °C and the reboiler vessel at 73.177 °C.
The isolated high H701 reading persists and rises to 419.92 °C; H702 is 84.267 °C and the vessel is 74.226 °C. Actual heater overheating versus a temperature-measurement fault is unresolved.
Distillate, reflux, and cooling-water flows remain present at 0.259, 0.428, and 3.643; both level switches remain at 1. These do not resolve the H701 anomaly.
